'''Enhanced optics suites''' were a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Armor accessory|enhancement]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A suite generally consisted of various audio and visual [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] which would be added to the helmet of an armor set. The sensors were capable of sophisticated passive light amplification, thermal signature reading, ultrasound pickup, [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeter]] wave emission, video capture, and common optical enhancement. The overall effect of the sensors was to provide the wearer with increased awareness of their surroundings during battle, and to allow them to see in conditions such as fog, darkness or smoke. Several models of suite were available, all costing about 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; these included the [[MULTI enhanced vision system]] by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]], the [[Full-spectrum optical enhancer]] by [[Atlas Corp]] and the [[Anq-Y enhanced optics suite]] by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Enhanced optics suites were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
